Great Meat and Vegetarian Menu, Prices, Service, and Atmosphere: A Winner All Around
Jan 2024 • Solo
Just the Facts:
Rico Taco, an authentic Mexican-owned HCM (D1) restaurant, features a reasonably priced diverse meat and vegetarian menu, a quaint and friendly atmosphere, and fast and friendly service, ensuring a satisfying dining experience for all.

The Rest of the Story:
Nestled in a charming courtyard among coffee and tea shops in HCM (D1), Rico Taco stands out with its authentic, fresh, and attractive dishes. The service is efficient, friendly, and fast, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. One notable aspect is the inclusive menu, catering to both meat and vegetarian diners with a variety of options for each dish.

An added bonus is the personal touch from owner David Torres, who goes out of his way to interact with each table, ensuring excellent dining service. Whether you're dining alone for a quick meal or gathering with friends, family, or colleagues, Rico Taco is a winner.
